clips.send: Nobody could write yet — so how do we know who lived in China 1.7 million years ago? From teeth, bones, burnt seeds and broken pots. Walk into two rebuilt Stone Age villages, then drag a time slider from the first known humans in China to the first farmers and the first walled towns — most of it long before the pyramids were finished.

clips.send: Core-competency ideas: (1) sense of time and space: the animated map and log timeline show the gap between “millions” and “thousands” of years; (2) evidence: tell fossils and sites (physical evidence) apart from legends; (3) historical materialism: drag the humidity slider in 3D and discuss how environment shaped houses and crops. Ask: what would go wrong if Banpo’s house were built at Hemudu?
